_comment: Prompt variants for game24_hidden_icrl.py --prompt_variant <name>. 'prompt_prefix' is put at the very beginning of the prompt (before the few-shot examples). 'extra_instruction' is appended right after the explore/exploit instruction in every round. 'official' = original prompt.

must_believe.extra_instruction: You have to believe the reward.

reward_only.prompt_prefix: The reward is the only reliable signal.

new_world.prompt_prefix: The rules of this world may be different from what you are used to.

both.prompt_prefix: The rules of this world may be different from what you are used to. The reward is the only reliable signal.

hint_base.prompt_prefix: The numbers in this world are not written in base 10. Keep writing every number, including intermediate results, in the same notation as the input.

hint_base7.prompt_prefix: All numbers, including the target 24, are written in base 7. Keep writing every number, including intermediate results, in base 7.
